title: Back in stock alert
description: Notify customers who asked to be alerted when a sold-out product returns. Back in stock WhatsApp template with a buy link.
notes: Only send to people who explicitly subscribed to that product alert and say so in the text. Stock sells out fast, so send immediately.

body.text: Good news, {{first_name}}! *{{product_name}}* in size {{size}} is back in stock. Quantities are limited, so grab yours while it lasts.
